newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Trade in Brazil's Lacta suspended-bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Brazil's Lacta suspended-bolsa.

text.p: Trade in shares of Brazilian chocolate maker Lacta was suspended Tuesday on the Sao Paulo bourse while buying and selling the stock of two other firms has resumed, the bolsa said.
A bolsa spokeswoman said Lacta shares will remain suspended until the company reveals the details of a general shareholders' meeting held Monday.
Meanwhile, trading in Parana state-owned power firm Copel and supermarket chain Pao de Acucar has resumed.
Copel was suspended Monday and restarted at the open Tuesday while trade in Pao de Acucar failed to open with the bourse but was resumed at 1415 local/1715 GMT, the spokeswoman said.
